subject: Aligning success metrics & acceptance tests for POC
messages:
From: Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@healthworks.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@healthworks.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning success metrics & acceptance tests for POC

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our engineering and clinical teams liked the latency profile and the ability to pin models per-environment. Before we lock dates with procurement, we need to align on what ‘success’ looks like for the 6-week proof-of-concept (POC).

High-level asks from our side:
- A clear list of acceptance tests we can run in our staging environment (including sample prompts/outputs).
- Exit gates: what are the minimum pass thresholds for pass/fail?
- A mutual action plan (owners + milestones) so we know who to engage for each test failure.

We’ve put a short internal checklist together but would like Redwood’s version so we can combine them into one MAP. Can you send a concise acceptance checklist and a proposed timeline?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

Aaron
Aaron Lim
Director, Clinical Ops
HealthWorks

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@healthworks.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@healthworks.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning success metrics & acceptance tests for POC

Aaron —

Appreciate the clear asks. I’m attaching a first-draft MAP and a companion acceptance-tests doc with sample prompts and expected signal thresholds. I’ll summarize the key pieces below so your team can review quickly.

TL;DR (6-week POC):
- Milestone 0 (Week 0): Kickoff + environment readiness (VPC peering, API keys, test dataset load). Owner: HealthWorks (Priya) + Redwood onboarding (Marissa).
- Milestone 1 (Week 1–2): Smoke tests — connectivity, auth, basic generation correctness. Pass: 95% of golden prompts return expected intent slot values; median token latency < 220ms. Owner: HealthWorks eng + Camila (Redwood).
- Milestone 2 (Week 3–4): Stress/concurrency — maintain 99% success rate at target throughput (X rps). Pass: <1% token error rate, 95th latency < 450ms under the load profile. Owner: HealthWorks SRE + Redwood infra (Jordan).
- Milestone 3 (Week 5–6): Edgecase & quality verification — evaluation against clinical QA set (N=1,200). Pass: aggregate precision >= 92% and no critical safety violations. Owner: HealthWorks clinical + Marissa (Redwood).
- Go/No-Go decision (end Week 6): Joint review and signoff; if any hard exit gate fails, we trigger a remediation sprint and pause cutover.

Exit gates and thresholds are conservative by default; we can relax them for a pilot if HealthWorks prefers a staged acceptance (e.g., non-blocking quality gaps with documented compensations).

Attachments included: MAP-HealthWorks-v1.xlsx (owners, dates, tasks), HW-acceptance-tests-v1.md (sample prompts, metrics, PASS/FAIL rules).

Can we target a quick sync Thursday to walk the MAP with your clinical QA lead? I recommend 30 minutes to confirm owners and whether the 6-week cadence fits your procurement window.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
Mobile: (650) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2026 08:51:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Aligning success metrics & acceptance tests for POC

Looping in a few operational details we typically see fail if not agreed up-front — I put three quick clarifications into the MAP spreadsheet:

1) Test dataset ownership: please confirm which dataset HealthWorks will load into staging vs. which scrubbed sample we should use. If you need Redwood to host the sample dataset, we need a signed DPA addendum before we mirror clinical data.
2) Failure response SLAs: if a hard gate fails during Week 3 stress testing, Redwood will allocate a patch window of up to 5 business days for prioritization under the dedicated POC support plan (see row 12 in MAP).
3) Observability hooks: we’ll provision a temporary dashboard (token-level latency and error rates) and include an SLI snapshot for your QA team to pull results. Expect link by EOD Monday after kickoff.

I also added a short smoke checklist to HW-acceptance-tests-v1.md — Camila, please flag anything we missed on infra sizing.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Aaron Lim <aaron.lim@healthworks.com>

Subject: Re: Aligning success metrics & acceptance tests for POC

Thanks — this looks helpful and more concrete than our draft. A few quick items from our side that I captured while reviewing:

- HealthWorks will host the clinical staging set; we’ll provide access to a scrubbed subset by Day −2 of kickoff. (Owner: Priya)
- We accept the 5-business-day remediation SLA for hard gate failures but want an escalation path to your engineering lead if a fix estimate exceeds 3 business days.
- Can you make the acceptance-tests doc explicit about the grading script (we’d like the exact script and scoring rules so QA can run locally)?

We can do the Thursday 30-minute sync — Priya and I are available 10:00–10:30 PT. If that works for you, we’ll consider the MAP soft-signed and start internal procurement tasks.

Appreciate the responsiveness — looking forward to the kickoff.

Aaron
Aaron Lim
